study_note: Official-protocol TD-MPC2 Humanoid Walk state benchmark over seeds 1-3 and 14M agent decisions per seed, with ten online evaluation episodes every 100k steps. The configured six MPPI iterations become eight at runtime through TD-MPC2's action_dim >= 20 heuristic. Model checkpoints and trajectory logs are disabled; W&B syncs online from node-local temporary storage, and only tiny evaluation CSVs plus Slurm output remain in Hydra home storage.
